comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.local.json to enforce team-flow rules automatically

before_merge.command: echo '[team-flow rule] Only Orchestrator merges. Are you the main session (not a subagent)? If yes, continue. If no, STOP.' && exit 1

before_commit.command: STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only); if echo "$STAGED" | grep -q -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|go|rs)$'; then if ! echo "$STAGED" | grep -q -E '(review-|qa-report|design\.md|contract\.md)'; then echo '[team-flow rule] Code changes require review-N.md or qa-report.md in same commit'; exit 1; fi; fi; exit 0
before_commit.description: Require review/QA artifact with code commits

before_push.command: BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); case "$BRANCH" in main|master|production|prod) echo '[team-flow rule] Cannot push to main/prod. Use feature/<task> branch and let Orchestrator merge after Human gate.' && exit 1;; esac
before_push.description: Prevent direct pushes to main or production
